say:1:1430122101:0.text: I was thinking the same thing, but the overseer wouldn't let me!
say:1:1430122101:0.source_cn: 我一开始也是这么想的……可是负责人不让！

say:2:1430122102:0.text: He said Brimstone Village was brimming with orders so we had to "save production capacity," and building a storehouse for the logs would be a waste.
say:2:1430122102:0.source_cn: 他说最近深岩村在执行什么“节约产能”的命令，搭建遮雨棚...

say:3:1430122103:0.text: That stone-brained idiot actually said waste! Doesn't he know that if it rains all the logs from Cedartown will get wet and damaged?!
say:3:1430122103:0.source_cn: 浪费？万一到时候下雨，这些从雪松镇运来的好木材可都会被淋湿！
